column1: # PREREG_E2E_R9M3A.tsv -- pre-registration of the Python/Lua public-API E2E points (S-D4). Written before any point is run;
# M3a does not run any point (only one no-injection smoke), M3b runs them twice for FLAKY detection.
# tolerance choice: element-wise relative error <= 1e-12 against the clean reference; the same binary and the same code path
#   are used, so a value change caused by a failed-then-retried solve would be many orders of magnitude larger; the 1e-12
#   band only absorbs floating-point noise from thread scheduling and does not mask state corruption.
# lua_retry_same: S4/main_lua.c:229-239 (S4L_error) closes the Lua state and exits when not interactive, so a failed solve
#   terminates the process and a same-object retry cannot be observed from the public API; NOT_APPLICABLE_PROCESS_EXIT.
